agenda_items.outcome_summary: Recreation Superintendent, Alice Guthrie - presented a program to provide free 90 day pass for recreation services to honor post 9/11 veterans.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION PROVIDING DIRECTION ON OPTIONS FOR REDUCING DISPOSABLE CHECKOUT BAG USE IN BOULDER.
